title: Expense reimbursement / 差旅报销规则（模拟）
text: This is a synthetic policy for demonstration, not a real company's rule. Employees must submit travel expense receipts within 30 calendar days after the trip ends. Hotel reimbursement is capped at CNY 500 per night in Beijing. Meal reimbursement is capped at CNY 100 per day. The policy does not specify any annual travel budget. 本文为模拟资料：差旅结束后30个自然日内提交票据；北京酒店报销上限每晚500元，餐补上限每天100元。

title: Customer data handling / 客户数据安全（模拟）
text: This synthetic handbook requires customer records to remain on approved internal systems. Do not upload customer names, telephone numbers, or identification numbers to a public AI service. Access must follow the least-privilege principle. Report suspected data exposure to the security team within one hour. 模拟制度：客户姓名、电话、证件号码不得上传公共AI服务；遵循最小权限原则；发现泄漏风险后一小时内上报安全团队。

title: Remote work / 远程办公（模拟）
text: Eligible employees may work remotely up to two days per week with manager approval. Interns follow their agreed attendance schedule. A remote day does not change required work hours. This document does not specify an internship salary. 模拟制度：符合条件的员工经主管同意每周最多远程办公两天；实习生按约定出勤；本文未规定实习薪资。

title: Leave requests / 请假申请（模拟）
text: Annual leave requests must be submitted at least five working days before the planned start. Emergency leave may be requested on the same day. Approval must be recorded in the attendance system. These are synthetic example rules. 模拟制度：年假至少提前五个工作日申请；紧急请假可当天提交；审批须在考勤系统留痕。

title: Intern onboarding / 实习入职（模拟）
text: An intern must complete account setup, confidentiality training, and a team orientation before accessing project data. The onboarding checklist must be completed within the first three working days. Each intern is assigned a mentor. This is synthetic demonstration content. 模拟流程：访问项目数据前完成账号开通、保密培训和团队介绍；前三个工作日完成入职清单；每位实习生安排一名导师。

title: Purchase approvals / 采购审批（模拟）
text: Purchases below CNY 2000 require team lead approval. Purchases at or above CNY 2000 require both team lead and finance approval. Software subscriptions must also pass a security review before purchase. These thresholds are synthetic. 模拟规则：2000元以下由组长审批；2000元及以上需组长与财务双重审批；软件订阅还需安全审查。

title: Model release checklist / 模型发布（模拟）
text: A model release must include a versioned dataset manifest, an evaluation report, a rollback plan, and owner approval. Results must be compared with the current production baseline. If the validation metric falls below the approved threshold, the release is blocked. This is synthetic content, not a production policy. 模拟清单：发布模型需数据版本清单、评测报告、回滚方案和负责人批准；指标须与当前基线比较；验证指标低于阈值则阻止发布。

title: Document versioning / 文档版本（模拟）
text: Policy documents must show a version number, owner, and effective date. Superseded documents must be archived and marked as obsolete. In a conflict, use the policy with the latest effective date approved by the owner. This demo has no real policy authority. 模拟规则：制度文档标注版本、负责人和生效日期；旧版归档并标为失效；冲突时使用负责人批准的最新生效版本。
